messages:
Maria G.: opened a small follow-up PR to the Console observability migration, focused on the dashboards + tracing hook examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4890 :wave:
Alex P.: skimmed. I see the Python snippet still uses old param `trace_key` (should be `trace_key_id`) and the Node sample has a missing await causing race in examples.
Jun L.: I can fix Python. Does `trace_key_id` match the SDK change from last month? want to ensure wording explains it's from SDK v2.3+.
Maria G.: yes please mention SDK v2.3+ in the paragraph above the snippet. simple parenthetical is fine.
Samir R.: I'll take Node await fix and the kv-cache example. current kv example shows manual prefixing like `key = "+sess:" + id`, we should switch to the helper: `await kv.setForSession(sessionId, payload)` so customers don't leak implementation details.
Elaine C.: small UX ask: add an inline anchor next to the cost table for "trace attribution" so users can deep link. also spotted 2 dead links to /sdk/node/legacy -> replace with /sdk/node/current.
Maria G.: good catch. can you also add a 1-line note near the cost/latency matrix about average sequence length affecting per-token cost? many users interpret token cost as fixed.
Alex P.: pushed a quick fix for `await` in Node sample and left an inline code-formatting nit.
Jun L.: pushed Python param fix and added a parenthetical: (SDK v2.3+). Also added a sentence: "Shorter average sequences improve batching efficiency and reduce per-token billing on busy routes."
Samir R.: updated kv sample to use `setForSession`, split into separate commit. fixed variable naming (sessId -> sessionId) and adjusted code fence spacing.
docs-bot: docs CI passed for PR #4890 (build 4721) :white_check_mark:
Elaine C.: replaced legacy links, added anchor `#trace-attribution`, and inserted short example filter: `trace_id = "{{trace_id}}"` for dashboard queries.
Alex P.: reviewed final patch, gave :+1: and requested squash of the tiny lint bot commit.
Maria G.: final checklist: 1) squash lint commit 2) Alex fix var naming confirmed 3) merge after noon. any blockers?
Jun L.: no blockers, thanks all.
Samir R.: none.
Maria G.: merging after squash unless objections. tagging #product-docs for visibility :sparkles:
__notes: thread about docs PR coordination: migration guide edits, snippet fixes (Python/Node/kv-cache), link replacements, small UX anchor addition, sequence-length cost note, CI pass. Slack-style short messages.
